# Bazozo

> Bazozo is an independent, one-person studio run by Harsimranjot Singh, based in India, building for clients worldwide (remote). The studio designs and builds across the full stack of modern digital work.

## Services

- Web design & development (marketing sites, web apps, e-commerce)
- Video editing (brand films, social content, documentaries)
- Browser extensions (Chrome, Firefox, Safari)
- WordPress plugin development
- Native mobile apps (Android, iOS)
- Native desktop apps (Windows, macOS)
- Native mobile games (Android, iOS)
- SEO, performance optimization, website migration/redesign, and related web services

## Portfolio

Bazozo has shipped 208 projects across the disciplines above. The full list, with descriptions, is listed on the homepage under the "Selected Work" section (https://bazozo.in/#work), organized by category with a working live-demo preview for every single project.
